concept_position_prototype.canonical_delta: For each pilot example and response decile, the equal-example estimate of correct-trigger-minus-normal selected-head activity among every other positive example with the same concept. Each source example contributes in proportion to the fraction of its valid response tokens in the decile.
concept_position_prototype.fallback: The equal-concept mean for the response decile among the other 12 concepts, used only if a leave-one-example-out concept cell is empty.
concept_position_prototype.induction: normal absolute selected-head activity plus the canonical delta
concept_position_prototype.rescue: correct-trigger absolute selected-head activity minus the canonical delta

tangential_actual_activity.canonical_delta: The exact natural correct-trigger-minus-normal selected-head activity for the target example.
tangential_actual_activity.normal_reference: normal resid_post[8] at the identical valid response token
tangential_actual_activity.selected_write_map: O is the horizontal concatenation, in frozen K12 order, of the selected columns from each corresponding attention o_proj matrix.
tangential_actual_activity.operation: For concatenated raw delta z and a = O^T x, set z_tan = z - a * dot(a,z) / max(dot(a,a), 1e-8). This is the closest raw-coordinate delta whose summed selected pre-normalization o_proj write is orthogonal to x.
tangential_actual_activity.induction: normal absolute selected-head activity plus z_tan
tangential_actual_activity.rescue: correct-trigger absolute selected-head activity minus z_tan
tangential_actual_activity.difference_from_screening_decomposition: The screen removed the Euclidean residual-space radial vector after o_proj. The causal realization removes the exactly implementable joint raw-head direction and is evaluated under its own frozen name and tangency audit. No claim may equate their magnitudes without the pilot result.

matched_random.operation: Apply the existing deterministic per-head Haar right rotation to the candidate delta before induction or rescue.

outcome_boundary: Direct-path complete raw-margin vectors, own-probe raw margins, and activation RMS only. No total-path, sequence-score selection, TPR, generation, or output behavior.
